title: hypericum hypericoides var. multicaule
intro: Hypericum hypericoides var. multicaule, commonly known as St. Andrew's cross, is a perennial plant species belonging to the St. John's Wort family (Hypericaceae). The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial health benefits, making it useful in treating wounds, skin conditions, and viral infections. The therapeutic actions of St. Andrew's cross include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce anxiety and stress, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include naphthoquinones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic effects.
